**Current positioning (WO2, what the journal accepts now):** No - not an active submission venue in 2026. Evidence: (1) ACM DL current TOC (https://dl.acm.org/toc/sigchi/current) shows the latest indexed issue is Vol 32 No 2 (~April 2000); (2) Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SIGCHI_Bulletin) states SIGCHI made 'interactions' its member publication starting in 2000, with the Bulletin continuing only as a supplement to interactions and later becoming online-only in 2003 rather than a normal peer-reviewed research journal; (3) WebSearch confirms 'Until 2000, the SIGCHI Bulletin was published as a membership publication... no longer actively published' and that SIGCHI's current member publications are ACM Interactions and ACM TechNews - SIGCHI Edition. No 2024-2026 article titles, aims-and-scope page for active submissions, or CFP could be located.
